title: Face oval and face perspective
plainLanguage: The face oval describes the projected head/face area in the image. Its width, height, and rotation should change with the view without changing the person’s identity.
purpose: Support consistent face fitting across front, three-quarter, tilted, and partially hidden heads.

rules.statement: Store face oval geometry separately from face-slot coordinates so either can be corrected without silently rewriting the other.
Compare face examples only after considering head view, oval aspect/rotation, and visibility.
If the face is hidden, verify hidden state rather than inventing the five slots.
Use controlled head-view references to distinguish true feature movement from perspective movement.

implementation.currentSupport: Face oval and five-slot editing already exist.
implementation.futureWork: Make similarity matching explicitly head-view aware.
